content: Your current {{admins}}-admin limit remains until the end of your billing period. If you exceed the new limit, charges will be based on your assigned admins.

comment.text: Body text for a warning dialog informing users how their current admin limit applies until the end of the billing period. The {{admins}} placeholder represents a numeric count of administrators.

usage.context:
<StorageWarning
 title={t("TariffAdminAdjustmentScheduled", {
 fromCount: currentTariffAdminsCount,
 toCount: nextTariffAdminsCount ?? 0,
 })}
 body={t("TariffAdminAdjustmentWarning", {
 admins: maxCountManagersByQuota,
 })}
 onCancelChange={handleCancelTariffDowngrade}
 isCancelLoading={isCancelDowngradeLoading}
 />
